meta.title: Chinese Cooking Demystified: Richmond dish crosswalk
meta.intro: A dish-by-dish crosswalk between the 99-item CCD regional catalog and current Richmond options. Match type measures menu fit, not restaurant quality.

classificationDefinitions.exact: The current menu or a current specialist source names the dish.
classificationDefinitions.close: The same dish family or technique, but not the catalog’s specific regional version.
classificationDefinitions.regional: A supported specialist for that cuisine; the exact dish was not found.
classificationDefinitions.gap: No credible current Richmond match was found.
classificationDefinitions.component: A technique, sauce, or home-cooking format rather than a sensible standalone restaurant target.

tomorrow.title: If you only have tomorrow
tomorrow.intro: Choose for rarity, group size, and exact-match breadth—not by trying to visit every lead.
